cases.text: For the month of January, pick all the Role Clarity & Meaningful Work questions and send them to all employees.
In November send the Culture & Inclusion questions to everyone.
Send the workload and wellbeing questions to G5 employees in December.
Career Development questions for G6 and above in the Technology business unit for February.
Leadership & Trust questions to employees in Chennai and Pune during March.
Send Recognition questions to all permanent employees except those in Hyderabad.
Innovation and AI readiness questions for the Data department, grades below G7, in October.
Manager Effectiveness questions to contract staff in Bengaluru in April.
For May, send questions to the Finance team.
Send the Collaboration and Communication & Change questions to the Sales business unit in June.
